notes: ZED Mini, under-slung below the gripper and mounted rolled 180 deg, so image up = node9 -Z. Optical axes: +X right, +Y down, +Z look (ZED SDK reports the LEFT camera as the reference frame). Origin is the LEFT lens front-surface centre derived from CAD (0807.stl / ZEDM.stl); the true imager sits a few mm behind the front glass, so subtract that along node9 +X once the datasheet offset is known. Right lens is at node9 [0.08527, 0.01968, -0.04206]; baseline is 63.0 mm along node9 +Y. This is not the mesh attachment point; see model/bundles/default/assets/camera/camera_frame.json for that.
